"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The working class has no voice, much less control, at their individual places of employment or in the political arena.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A working class takeover of the Democratic Party on the grounds that it is the “more progressive” of the two capitalist parties is a dead end.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party’s underlying logic is dictated by the interests of capital, which are antagonistic to the interests of the working class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party functions as a controlled opposition.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party functions as a mechanism by which the ruling class can diffuse any popular energies that could be harnessed for building a truly democratic society.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Efforts by DSA chapters to contest Democratic Party leadership positions at the local level are rejected.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ideas and groups that exist within DSA that channel efforts into NGO coalitions where DSA is the junior partner and can only mobilize activists are rejected.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
